faqs.question: Can we take both gummies together?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can use hair gummies post a meal & magnesium gummies in the evening, 1-2 hours before bed. They both can be taken together as well.

faqs.question: Are these gummies safe for everyone?
faqs.answer: Yes they are safe. However in case of specific allergies, we recommend speaking to a healthcare professional.

faqs.question: Can Magnesium help with anxiety and stress?
faqs.answer: Yes, Magnesium is known to help reduce stress and anxiety by balancing neurotransmitter levels and lowering stress hormones. Additionally, it also helps with muscle cramps/pain relief & aids in 300+ biochemical reactions in the body.

faqs.question: Are there any side effects of taking Magnesium?
faqs.answer: Magnesium is generally well-tolerated when taken as directed. Our gummies combine five forms of magnesium with vitamins B6, D3, and B9 for optimal absorption and efficacy, while being 100% natural and free from added sugar. Adhering to the recommended serving ensures safe use. For individuals with specific health conditions or on medication, consulting a healthcare professional is advised.

faqs.question: Does stress lead to hair fall?
faqs.answer: Yes, stress can trigger hair fall by disrupting hair growth cycles, causing shedding and thinning over time.

faqs.question: If it is sugar-free, how are these gummies sweet?
faqs.answer: Our gummies are sweetened with chicory root extract which is a naturally-sourced prebiotic fiber.

faqs.question: Do I need to take a blood test before taking Magnesium?
faqs.answer: No, a blood test is generally unnecessary for healthy adults who wish to take magnesium supplements at recommended doses unless symptoms or certain medical conditions suggest an imbalance.

faqs.question: How is this 5-in-1 form better?
faqs.answer: Our 5-in-1 Magnesium formulation provides a higher amount of elemental magnesium compared to single-form supplements. The advanced encapsulation technology not only enhances absorption and effectiveness but also delivers the unique benefits of all five Magnesium salts, supporting muscle recovery, relaxation, and sleep, with added Vitamins B6, D3, and B9 for overall wellness.
